E1_3.note: nested: every threshold / model fitted on the training patients of each outer fold (R49 / P1 flags of training endoscopies from inner out-of-fold scores and the fold's own cut-offs; tile summaries of training samples under the inner models of that split), applied to the held-out fold; eps = largest share of training flagged progressor endoscopies a veto may remove; vetoed endoscopies keep their sequencing; apparent = threshold or model chosen on the evaluated endoscopies themselves (optimistic, labelled); deltas: paired patient bootstrap (rv8 pdraws, RandomState(0)), thresholds and calls fixed; P1 matched = P1 threshold re-matched per repeat and per draw to the rule's realised endoscopy sensitivity (rv8b S1 (i))
